author: Doug Keele
text: Had a great experience with B&D plumbing on a boiler issue. I had been through multiple other companies that were unable to provide a solution. I felt they were very knowledgeable on boiler set ups. They were easy to communicate with.  Fair price and quality work. Will definitely use for any plumbing needs in the future.

author: Kerry Wokatsch
text:
B & D Plumbing was prompt, professional, communicated well, all at a fair price. We had a bad situation with our well, the connections from the well, and the water softener. B & D fit us in when we needed them. We are very grateful. Don’t hesitate to call B & D for anything related to your plumbing.

Randy Wokatsch
Marathon

author: Haley Theilig
text: B&D helped me numerous times since purchasing my home four years ago and I cannot say enough about their exceptional customer service and professionalism! Anytime I called, I had nothing but a positive experience from start to finish whether it was  repairing my water heater or fully replacing my old sump pump system/bringing it back up to code. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a dependable & local business to partner with!

author: Maxwell Hoogland
text: After trying to deal with a home warranty company for three weeks for a water heater, I decided to just call somebody. They were here and had my water heater up and going in less than 20 hours from first contact. Very professional and do great work!

author: Bryan Bissonnette
text: A true lifesaver!!  B & D plumbing came through at the last minute.  Was in contact with them and the warranty company throughout the week and at the last minute our water heater went out.  The team made sure we were taken care of.  We highly recommend this company.
